masteryZone.q: When was the ODOP scheme launched?
masteryZone.sol: The ODOP scheme was launched on January 24, 2018.

masteryZone.q: What is the revised financial benefit under Kanya Sumangala Yojana?
masteryZone.sol: The financial benefit was hiked to Rs. 25,000 per eligible girl starting from 2024-25.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The ODOP scheme covers all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.
masteryZone.sol: True. Every district has one designated indigenous product promoted under the scheme.

masteryZone.q: Which city is famous as the glass and bangle capital under the ODOP scheme?
Which scheme provides free coaching for competitive exams in UP?
masteryZone.sol: Mukhyamantri Abhyuday Yojana provides free coaching for civil services, JEE, NEET, and NDA.

masteryZone.q: Which digital device is distributed under the Swami Vivekananda Yuva Scheme?
masteryZone.sol: Smartphones and tablets are distributed to final-year students of UG/PG/Technical courses.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Abhyuday Yojana centers are set up at every Gram Panchayat level.
masteryZone.sol: False. Abhyuday coaching centers are set up at the Divisional (Mandal) level headquarters.

masteryZone.q: What is the integrated emergency helpline number for women safety under Mission Shakti?
How many days of free training is provided under VSSY?
masteryZone.sol: Artisans receive 6 days of training followed by toolkit distribution under the Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana.

masteryZone.q: Which expressway connects Meerut to Prayagraj?
masteryZone.sol: Ganga Expressway connects Meerut to Prayagraj with a length of approx 594 km.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Bundelkhand Expressway connects Lucknow to Ghazipur.
masteryZone.sol: False. Purvanchal Expressway connects Lucknow to Ghazipur. Bundelkhand Expressway connects Chitrakoot to Etawah.

masteryZone.q: Under the ODOP scheme, which city is known as 'Pital Nagari'?
